summary: Iter237 — Merchant App: PWA push notifications + Pause/Busy mode end-to-end testing. Backend pytest 3/3 PASS on tests/test_merchant_availability.py (pause blocks orders 409 → resume 200, _is_paused helper auto-resume after pause_until, is_open reflects pause). Larger regression suite 20/20 stable (test_merchant_availability + test_merchant_stock + test_merchant_bi + test_grouped_delivery). Frontend Playwright UI 100% PASS on /merchant/orders: merchant-orders, push-toggle (clickable, shows graceful 'Notifications bloquées' fallback when context blocks permission — GET /api/push/vapid-public-key returns 200 with valid key), sound-toggle, ws-status='En direct' (WS connected), pause-toggle opens pause-menu containing pause-15/pause-30/pause-60/pause-indef, selecting pause-30 closes the menu + shows paused-banner + swaps button to resume-btn, clicking Reprendre removes banner and restores pause-toggle. Tabs pending/active/completed all navigate correctly. No critical or minor bugs found.
verified_scenarios: GET /api/push/vapid-public-key → 200 with publicKey starting with 'BLTnMoIn...' — PASS.
POST /api/orders during pause → 409 'Ce commerce est en pause...' — PASS (pytest).

_is_paused helper: accepting_orders=True → False; accepting_orders=False+pause_until=null → True; accepting_orders=False+pause_until=future → True; accepting_orders=False+pause_until=past → False (auto-resume) — PASS (pytest).
GET /api/merchants/{id} after pause: accepting_orders=false, is_open=false — PASS (pytest).
UI /merchant/orders: merchant-orders root visible after merchant login — PASS.
UI: push-toggle, sound-toggle, ws-status (text='En direct'), tab-pending/active/completed all visible — PASS.
UI: initial state shows pause-toggle (accepting). Click pause-toggle → pause-menu visible with pause-15, pause-30, pause-60, pause-indef — PASS.
UI: Click pause-30 → menu closes, paused-banner appears with 'Boutique en pause', resume-btn replaces pause-toggle — PASS.
UI: Click resume-btn → paused-banner disappears, pause-toggle returns — PASS.

UI: push-toggle clickable; in automation context notification permission blocked, app shows graceful toast 'Notifications bloquées. Autorisez-les dans les réglages du navigateur.' — expected behaviour, no crash — PASS.
UI: Tabs navigation pending → active → completed → pending works — PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: MerchantOrders.js: clean separation of state (accepting, pauseUntil, showPauseMenu, pushOn, soundOn). PAUSE_DURATIONS array drives the menu rendering, mins=0 maps to data-testid='pause-indef' via fallback (d.mins || 'indef') — works correctly.
Pause menu auto-closes after selection because setAvailability(false, mins) sets accepting=false → the {showPauseMenu && accepting && ...} guard hides it. Good UX.
routes/merchants.py _is_paused correctly auto-resumes when pause_until elapses (returns False), preventing stuck-pause state.
routes/orders.py blocks order creation with 409 + clear French error 'Ce commerce est en pause...' — proper status code (not 400/500).
GET /api/push/vapid-public-key responds publicly without auth — correct for service-worker registration flow.
Push toast fallback when Notification permission denied — no JS errors; UX preserved.
WebSocket connection warning in console ('WebSocket is closed before the connection is established') is benign — page reconnects and ws-status shows 'En direct'.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixtures create+cleanup TEST_ merchants/products/orders per test. Manual UI test toggled merchant@example.com pause state on/off and left it RESUMED (final state = accepting orders).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA push + pause/busy feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend endpoint POST /api/merchants/me/availability accepts {accepting_orders:bool, pause_minutes:int?} and persists pause_until (ISO). Order creation checks _is_paused and returns 409 when paused. /api/push/vapid-public-key public, /api/push/subscribe requires auth. Frontend MerchantOrders.js exposes all required data-testids exactly as in the spec. Push permission cannot be granted in headless Playwright by default — UI gracefully shows 'Notifications bloquées' toast, which is acceptable per the review_request guidance.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs. Feature works as specified.
